quests.title: A gem on every cell
quests.ask: Here every cell after the robot's holds a gem. Walk the whole row and leave none behind, the last cell included.
quests.nudge: Watch the replay: when the robot looks for a gem, which cell is it standing on?

quests.title: A row with no gems
quests.ask: This row is empty. Walk to the far end without a crash: the robot should only pick where there is something to pick.
quests.nudge: What happens if you reach for a gem that isn't there? How could the robot find out first?

quests.title: Gems here and there
quests.ask: Gems in other places than the challenge's row. Collect them all.
quests.nudge: If your program only works for one row, what does it rely on?
